# `tmux-control`

**Usage**: `tmux-control [FLAGS] <SUBCOMMAND>`

- **Usage**: `tmux-control [FLAGS] <SUBCOMMAND>`

## Flags

### `--json`

Emit machine-readable JSON output

### `-q --quiet`

Suppress non-error output

### `-v --verbose`

Log debug-level info to stderr

### `--no-color`

Disable colors
